spells.name: Imbibe
spells.note: 4s cast at 100 energy — drains the two nearest fountains, firing their Expulsions, spawning living venoms and (Mythic) a Malignant Tumor; the master timeline for the fight.

spells.name: Prepare Blood
spells.note: Telegraph only — marks the Bleeding Snake Fountain as one of the two about to drain; no damage.

spells.name: Prepare Fire
spells.note: Telegraph only — marks the Burning Snake Fountain as one of the two about to drain; no damage.

spells.name: Prepare Shadow
spells.note: Telegraph only — marks the Shadow Snake Fountain as one of the two about to drain; no damage.

spells.name: Blood Infusion
spells.note: Boss buff from draining the Bleeding Snake Fountain — empowers Hemo Expulsion and sets Adaptive Infection to the blood variant (wowhead-confirmed).

spells.name: Shadow Infusion
spells.note: Boss buff from draining the Shadow Snake Fountain — empowers Gloom Expulsion and sets Adaptive Infection to the shadow variant.

spells.name: Flame Infusion
spells.note: Boss buff from draining the Burning Snake Fountain — empowers Conflagrating Expulsion and sets Adaptive Infection to the fire variant.

spells.name: Toxic Vapor
spells.note: 300yd Nature tick every 2s, one stack per Imbibe — the soft enrage; unavoidable and never a player failure.

spells.name: Virulent Fumes
spells.note: Driver aura for the Virulent Fumes damage component (1291467) — carries no damage of its own.

spells.name: Virulent Fumes
spells.note: Nature damage from the toxic haze the venoms leave behind — only 6 of 20 players took it on Mythic, so it is positional and avoidable.

spells.name: Dripping Fangs
spells.note: Boss cast on the active tank that applies the 1280934 debuff; the gaps between casts are the tank's repositioning window for the next Imbibe.

spells.name: Dripping Fangs
spells.note: 32s tank debuff — Nature every 2s plus +100% Physical damage taken (200% on Mythic), no dispel type; requires a swap.

spells.name: Adaptive Infection
spells.note: Parent cast — applies one of the three infection variants depending on which Infusions are active.

spells.name: Stygian Infection
spells.note: Shadow variant — Shadow damage every 1.5s plus a 100-150% healing absorb; wowhead lists no dispel type, so healers cannot cleanse it.

spells.name: Stygian Burst
spells.note: 6yd Shadow eruption dropped beneath a Stygian Infection carrier — standing in one is the failure.

spells.name: Exploding Infection
spells.note: Fire variant — periodic Fire damage, then the carrier detonates Caustic Explosion when it ends; wowhead lists a Magic dispel type but every guide says it erupts on expiry and no raid dispels it (zero dispel events in the whole log corpus), so it is a placed bomb, not a cleanse target.

spells.name: Caustic Explosion
spells.note: Fire detonation when Exploding Infection ends, falling off with distance — only 4 players were hit in the log sample, so a non-carrier hit means they were too close.

spells.name: Siphoning Infection
spells.note: Blood variant and the deadliest of the three — Shadow damage, a 150% healing absorb AND -100% healing received; wowhead lists no dispel type.

spells.name: Siphon Blood
spells.note: 10yd Physical drain around a Siphoning Infection carrier — being inside that radius is the failure.

spells.name: Plague Froth
spells.note: The 2s boss channel that coats 3-5 players; locks Vashnik's movement and facing.

spells.name: Plague Froth
spells.note: Periodic driver on the frothed player for 6s, then expires into Plague Wave — use this to identify carriers.

spells.name: Plague Froth
spells.note: 2s marker aura component of the Plague Froth cluster.

spells.name: Plague Froth
spells.note: Nature+Shadow damage in a 4.5yd radius around each carrier — the carrier eating it is expected, anyone else failed to clear the bubble.

spells.name: Plague Wave
spells.note: Nature+Shadow waves erupting in four cardinal directions when Plague Froth expires; on Mythic these are the only way to strip Hardened Tumor.

spells.name: Malignant Burst
spells.note: THE wipe mechanic — 1.5s cast when a living venom reaches the Malignant Cavity, 300yd Nature burst plus a stacking DoT every 3s for 30s; 45 killing blows in six Mythic pulls.

spells.name: Malignant Catalyst
spells.note: Heroic+ only — 5s boss cast forming an orb of venom above the Malignant Cavity.

spells.name: Malignant Catalyst
spells.note: Heroic+ only — internal driver for the Catalyst orb.

spells.name: Malignant Catalyst
spells.note: Heroic+ only — unavoidable Nature damage as the orb bursts and launches Catalytic Bile; attribute deaths, never a per-player failure.

spells.name: Catalytic Bile
spells.note: Heroic+ only — 6yd Nature hit capped at 1 target, the hit an assigned soaker is SUPPOSED to take; taking it is correct, dying to it is a defensive problem.

spells.name: Catalytic Bile
spells.note: Heroic+ only — 300yd Nature raid punish (80 on Mythic vs 40 elsewhere) when a bile is not intercepted and reaches the Cavity; 9 killing blows on Mythic.

spells.name: Hemo Expulsion
spells.note: Unavoidable raid-wide Shadow damage when Imbibe drains the Bleeding Snake Fountain; also spawns the Clotting Venoms.

spells.name: Gloom Expulsion
spells.note: Unavoidable 400yd Shadow damage when Imbibe drains the Shadow Snake Fountain; also spawns the Shrouded Venoms.

spells.name: Conflagrating Expulsion
spells.note: Unavoidable raid-wide Fire damage when Imbibe drains the Burning Snake Fountain; also spawns the Burning Venoms.

spells.name: Deadly Venom
spells.note: Nature ground DoT reapplied every 1.2s while you stand in the trail a living venom leaves — every application is a player standing in it.

adds.name: Burning Venom
adds.note: Living venom pulled from the Burning Snake Fountain by Imbibe. Crawls toward the Malignant Cavity — must die before it arrives or it triggers Malignant Burst (1280189)

spells.name: Burning Presence
spells.note: 300yd Fire pulse every 3s while a Burning Venom is alive — wowhead confirms raid-wide radius and 18 of 20 players were hit on Mythic, so this is add-uptime pressure, NOT a positioning failure.

spells.name: Caustic Surge
spells.note: Fire eruption plus a stacking Fire DoT when the Burning Venom dies — a large slice of the raid hit on one cast means it was killed inside the stack.

adds.name: Clotting Venom
adds.note: Living venom pulled from the Bleeding Snake Fountain by Imbibe. Immune to crowd control and splits into smaller clots on death. Must die before it reaches the Malignant Cavity

spells.name: Sanguineous Fortitude
spells.note: Self-buff granting immunity to Disarm, Disorient, Fear, Slow, Root and Stun — Clotting Venoms cannot be kited or CC'd, only killed.

spells.name: Clotting Blood
spells.note: Healing-absorb debuff, Magic dispel type on wowhead and genuinely dispelled 126 times across 332 applications in the log corpus.

spells.name: Splitting Clot
spells.note: Wowhead-confirmed 10yd trigger missile — the Clotting Venom splits into smaller clots on death and each split still walks for the Cavity.

adds.name: Shrouded Venom
adds.note: Living venom pulled from the Shadow Snake Fountain by Imbibe. NPC ID NEEDED — the Shadow fountain was never drained in the six logged Mythic pulls, so this add never appeared. Look up via WCL on a log where Shadow Infusion is active

spells.name: Miasmic Coating
spells.note: Wowhead-confirmed all-school absorb shield worth 100% of the Shrouded Venom's max health — break it before the add can be killed.

spells.name: Umbral Ejection
spells.note: Wowhead-confirmed 3yd Shadow missiles fired at nearby players when the Shrouded Venom dies — clear out before it drops.

spells.name: Congealing Bolt
spells.note: 5s Shadow hit plus a movement snare, Magic dispel type on wowhead and genuinely dispelled 58 times across 300 applications in the log corpus.

adds.name: Malignant Tumor
adds.note: MYTHIC ONLY. Pulled from the fountains alongside the venoms by Imbibe. WCL reports this actor as 'Malignant Totem' with non-standard actor IDs (808290 / 538860) rather than a real NPC ID — NPC ID NEEDED, look up via the WCL combatants list on a Mythic log

spells.name: Hardened Tumor
spells.note: MYTHIC ONLY. 99% damage reduction on the tumor until a Plague Wave (1295798) strips it; log-confirmed only, no wowhead page exists for this ID.

spells.name: Malignance
spells.note: MYTHIC ONLY. A surviving tumor fires a 300yd Nature burst plus a tick every 2s for a full minute — 12 killing blows on Mythic, second only to Malignant Burst.
